name: SamMsg
meaning: message ids seen in the Sam module (names inferred from behaviour). Sent BY Sam to the Wolf: 0x400,0x403,0x404,0x408,0x40B,0x40C,0x40D,0x410,0x419; to carried objects: 4,0xE,0xF,0x23,0x24,0x4601; received: 0,0xE,0x1D,0x33,0x38,0x4A,0x69,0x77,0x480,0x481,0x482

name: MSG_KILL
meaning: to Sam: param 0 fade-out, param 2 knock-out; Sam->Robot param 0 = hit robot

name: MSG_FREEZE
meaning: Sam->Wolf when carried; to Sam: carried object lost

name: MSG_WOLF_CAUGHT
meaning: param 0 grab, 1 (from state 8 end), 2 hit, 3 release

name: MSG_WOLF_IS_RUNNING
meaning: queried in Sam_UpdateGoalPos for aim lead (move flag 0x40)

name: MSG_SAM_FETCH_NOTIFY
meaning: stores param in +0xa30 when fetching the Wolf

name: MSG_INFLATABLE_QUERY
meaning: sent to class 0x84 (InflatableSheep) before pick-up; 0 = cannot be picked
